title: Cartwise Grocery Orders Item Issue Refunds: Window, Line and Destination
content:
## Refund desk rule — item issue refunds on an order

This rule governs item issue refunds — missing, damaged, wrong item and quality — on Cartwise Grocery Orders orders: when they are available, how often a line can be refunded, and where the money goes.

### Clauses

**1. (Retired, no longer in force.)** A missing, damaged, wrong item or quality refund targets one billed line, named by order and line number, and pays back that line's charge for the affected units at the billed unit price. This clause is superseded by the current basis.

**2. Completed order and issue window.** Item issues are refunded only on a completed order and only when reported within the issue window counted from the order's completion.
- The order's status on the order record must be completed.
- The window is counted in calendar days from the date part of the order's completion time as day 0, and the last day to report is that date plus the service level's issue-report window days, inclusive. The time of day of the completion does not move day 0.
- Both facts are read from the order record of the order being refunded.

**3. (Retired, no longer in force.)** A damaged or quality refund on a line charged above the service level's photo threshold needs a photo on the case; without one it is registered for review as a photo review. This clause is superseded by the current basis.

**4. (Retired, no longer in force.)** The agent may grant item refunds on one order only up to the lower of the service level's self-service refund cap in dollars and its self-service refund cap percentage of the order's item subtotal, counting the item refunds already granted on the order; the part above the cap is registered for review as an over-cap review and is not booked. This clause is superseded by the current basis.

**5. Once per line and reason.** Each line can be refunded once per refund reason, and never for more than the line's charge less what was already refunded on it. The check is made against the item refund entries already standing on that same order line.

**6. Destination.** Refunds go to the service level's default refund destination unless the customer asks for Cartwise credit.

### The issue window at its boundary

Let the completion date be day 0 and the service level's issue-report window be W days (W is read from the service level; the cases below hold for any W).

| Report made on | Within the window |
|---|---|
| Day 0 (the completion date itself, at any hour) | Yes |
| The completion date plus W days (the boundary day) | Yes — the last day is inclusive |
| The day after the boundary day | No |

A completion late in the evening does not shorten the window: that date is still day 0.

### Status and window together

| Order status | Reported within the window | Item issue refund |
|---|---|---|
| Completed | Yes | Available under this rule |
| Completed | No | Not available |
| Any status other than completed (placed, shopping, en route, ready for pickup, returned, canceled, closed) | — | Not available |

### Once per line and reason — points of judgement

- *A second damaged refund asked for on a line that already carries a damaged refund* — not available; the line has had its refund for that reason.
- *A quality refund on a line that already carries a missing refund for part of its units* — a different reason, so not barred by the once-per-reason test, but the amount can never exceed the line's charge less everything already refunded on the line.
- *A line whose whole charge has already been refunded* — nothing remains to refund on it under any reason.
